# selector page

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:selectorPage`](gmeow-selectorPage.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record the page or page range a [`gmeow:Selector`](../classes/gmeow-Selector.md) pinpoints within a cited work.

### Avoid when

- Avoid it for non-paginated loci (use [`gmeow:selectorTextPosition`](gmeow-selectorTextPosition.md) for an offset or [`gmeow:selectorLocator`](gmeow-selectorLocator.md) for a section) and avoid the bearing [`CitationAct`](../classes/gmeow-CitationAct.md) — page sits on the [`Selector`](../classes/gmeow-Selector.md).

### How to use

- Set [`gmeow:selectorPage`](gmeow-selectorPage.md) on a [`gmeow:Selector`](../classes/gmeow-Selector.md) as a literal page or range; combine with [`gmeow:selectorTextQuote`](gmeow-selectorTextQuote.md) when the exact passage also matters.

### Examples

- ex:page42 [`gmeow:selectorPage`](gmeow-selectorPage.md) "42-44".
